name: 搜索任务
desc: 任务区搜索框按关键词匹配标题 / 描述（忽略大小写）：只在显示层过滤当前分组 + 当前视图（全部 / 已归档 / 垃圾桶都生效），统计与底栏计数不受影响；搜索时显示「找到 N 项」与清除按钮、隐藏拖拽手柄（可见顺序与 todos 槽位不再一致）；无匹配时给出空状态文案；清除后恢复全部；刷新后搜索词不保留（不进存储）

steps.eval: if (typeof T === 'undefined') { window.T = {}; } T.wipe = async () => { const { getStorage } = await import('/nos/storage/main.js'); const s = getStorage('conjure-todo-app-test'); sessionStorage.setItem('__todo_store_id', JSON.stringify({ id: 'conjure-todo-app-test', exp: Date.now() + 600000 })); const K = '__todo_test_backup_v1'; if (localStorage.getItem('__todo_test_dirty') === '1') { const o = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(K) || 'null'); if (o) { if (o.todos) await s.setItem('todos', o.todos); if (o.groups) await s.setItem('groups', o.groups); if (o.ui) await s.setItem('ui', o.ui); } } const snap = { todos: await s.getItem('todos'), groups: await s.getItem('groups'), ui: await s.getItem('ui') }; localStorage.setItem(K, JSON.stringify(snap)); localStorage.setItem('__todo_test_dirty', '1'); await s.removeItem('todos'); await s.removeItem('groups'); await s.removeItem('ui'); sessionStorage.removeItem('todo-ui-state'); return 'wiped, backup todos=' + (snap.todos ? snap.todos.length : 0); }; return await T.wipe();

if (typeof T === 'undefined') { window.T = {}; } T.q = (s) => { const p = document.querySelector('o-page'); const r = p && p.shadowRoot; return r ? Array.from(r.querySelectorAll(s)) : []; }; T.ready = async (sel, ms) => { const n = Math.ceil((ms || 3000) / 100); for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { if (T.q(sel).length) return true; await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 100)); } throw new Error('页面就绪超时，找不到 ' + sel); }; T.tx = (el) => el.textContent.trim(); T.click = (el) => { if (!el) throw new Error('元素不存在'); const b = el.shadowRoot && el.shadowRoot.querySelector('button'); (b || el).click(); return true; }; T.byText = (sel, t) => T.q(sel).find((e) => T.tx(e) === t) || null; T.btn = (t) => T.click(T.byText('st-button', t)); T.dlg = () => T.q('st-dialog').find((d) => d.hasAttribute('open')) || null; T.dlgBtn = (t) => { const d = T.dlg(); if (!d) throw new Error('当前没有打开的弹窗'); return T.click(Array.from(d.querySelectorAll('st-button')).find((b) => T.tx(b) === t)); }; T.wait = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms || 300)); T.NL = String.fromCharCode(10); T.setVal = (el, v) => { if (!el) throw new Error('输入元素不存在'); el.value = v; el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); return true; }; T.items = () => T.q('.item'); T.titles = () => T.items().map((i) => T.tx(i.querySelector('.text'))); T.item = (t) => T.items().find((x) => T.tx(x.querySelector('.text')) === t) || null; T.need = (t) => { const i = T.item(t); if (!i) throw new Error('找不到任务：' + t); return i; }; T.empty = () => { const e = T.q('.empty')[0]; return e ? T.tx(e) : null; }; T.hint = () => T.tx(T.q('.search-count')[0]); T.handleDisplay = () => { const h = T.q('.item .drag-handle')[0]; return h ? getComputedStyle(h).display : 'none'; }; T.search = async (kw) => { const host = T.q('.search-field')[0]; if (!host) throw new Error('找不到搜索框'); const inner = host.shadowRoot.querySelector('input'); inner.value = kw; inner.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true, composed: true })); await T.wait(320); return T.titles(); }; T.view = (t) => T.click(T.q('st-button-group st-button').find((b) => T.tx(b).indexOf(t) === 0)); T.labels = () => T.q('st-button-group st-button').map((b) => T.tx(b)); T.toggle = (t) => T.click(T.need(t).querySelector('st-checkbox').shadowRoot.querySelector('input')); T.del = (t) => { const b = Array.from(T.need(t).querySelectorAll('.item-actions st-icon-button')).find((x) => (x.getAttribute('title') || '').indexOf('删除') !== -1); if (!b) throw new Error('行尾找不到删除按钮'); return T.click(b); }; T.addTask = async (title, desc) => { T.btn('添加任务'); await T.wait(400); const d = T.dlg(); if (!d) throw new Error('添加弹窗未打开'); T.setVal(d.querySelector('.dialog-field'), desc ? title + T.NL + desc : title); await T.wait(280); T.dlgBtn('添加'); await T.wait(420); return true; }; return 'helpers ready';

await T.ready('.search-bar'); const host = T.q('.search-field')[0]; if (!host) throw new Error('任务区应有搜索框'); if (host.getAttribute('placeholder') !== '搜索任务…') throw new Error('搜索框 placeholder 不正确：' + host.getAttribute('placeholder')); const inner = host.shadowRoot.querySelector('input'); const iw = parseFloat(getComputedStyle(inner).width); if (!(iw > 80 && iw < 240)) throw new Error('搜索框应是紧凑的小尺寸（实际输入区 ' + iw + 'px）'); const group = T.q('.toolbar st-button-group')[0]; if (!group) throw new Error('筛选按钮组应在 .toolbar 内'); const gr = group.getBoundingClientRect(); const sr = host.getBoundingClientRect(); if (Math.abs(gr.top - sr.top) > 12) throw new Error('搜索框应与筛选按钮在同一行（top ' + gr.top + ' vs ' + sr.top + '）'); if (!(sr.left > gr.right)) throw new Error('搜索框应在筛选按钮右侧'); if (T.q('.toolbar').length !== 1) throw new Error('筛选与搜索应包在同一个 .toolbar 里'); const cnt = T.q('.search-count')[0]; if (getComputedStyle(cnt).display !== 'none') throw new Error('未搜索时「找到 N 项」应隐藏'); if (getComputedStyle(T.q('.search-bar st-icon-button')[0]).display !== 'none') throw new Error('未搜索时清除按钮应隐藏'); await T.addTask('买牛奶', '两盒' + T.NL + '顺便买鸡蛋'); await T.addTask('写周报', '本周总结和下周计划'); await T.addTask('Buy Milk'); if (T.items().length !== 3) throw new Error('应有 3 条任务，实际 ' + T.titles()); return 'ok';

let r = await T.search('牛奶'); if (r.length !== 1 || r[0] !== '买牛奶') throw new Error('按标题搜索应只命中「买牛奶」，实际 ' + r); if (T.hint() !== '找到 1 项') throw new Error('命中数提示不正确：' + T.hint()); if (T.handleDisplay() !== 'none') throw new Error('搜索时应隐藏拖拽手柄（可见顺序与存储槽位不一致）'); if (getComputedStyle(T.q('.search-bar st-icon-button')[0]).display === 'none') throw new Error('搜索时清除按钮应可见'); const f = T.tx(T.q('.footer .count')[0]); if (f !== '3 项未完成 · 共 3 项') throw new Error('搜索不应改变统计口径：' + f); r = await T.search('总结'); if (r.length !== 1 || r[0] !== '写周报') throw new Error('按描述搜索应命中「写周报」，实际 ' + r); r = await T.search('buy'); if (r.length !== 1 || r[0] !== 'Buy Milk') throw new Error('搜索应忽略大小写，实际 ' + r); r = await T.search('milk'); if (r.length !== 1 || r[0] !== 'Buy Milk') throw new Error('小写关键词应命中「Buy Milk」，实际 ' + r); return 'ok';

const r = await T.search('zzz没有这条zzz'); if (r.length !== 0) throw new Error('无匹配时不应有任务行，实际 ' + r); if (T.hint() !== '找到 0 项') throw new Error('无匹配时命中数应为 0：' + T.hint()); const e = T.empty(); if (!e || e.indexOf('没有符合「zzz没有这条zzz」的任务') === -1) throw new Error('无匹配时应给出空状态文案，实际 ' + e); T.click(T.q('.search-bar st-icon-button')[0]); await T.wait(320); if (T.items().length !== 3) throw new Error('点清除按钮后应恢复全部 3 条，实际 ' + T.titles()); if (T.empty()) throw new Error('恢复后不应再显示空状态'); if (getComputedStyle(T.q('.search-count')[0]).display !== 'none') throw new Error('清除后「找到 N 项」应隐藏'); if (T.handleDisplay() === 'none') throw new Error('清除后拖拽手柄应恢复可见'); return 'ok';

T.toggle('买牛奶'); await T.wait(450); T.btn('归档已完成'); await T.wait(520); T.view('已归档'); await T.wait(450); if (T.items().length !== 1) throw new Error('已归档视图应有 1 条，实际 ' + T.titles()); let r = await T.search('牛奶'); if (r.length !== 1 || r[0] !== '买牛奶') throw new Error('已归档视图内搜索应命中归档项，实际 ' + r); r = await T.search('周报'); if (r.length !== 0) throw new Error('已归档视图内搜索不应命中未归档项，实际 ' + r); const e = T.empty(); if (!e || e.indexOf('没有符合「周报」的任务') === -1) throw new Error('已归档视图无匹配时应有空状态文案，实际 ' + e); const f = T.tx(T.q('.footer .count')[0]); if (f !== '已归档 1 项') throw new Error('搜索不应改变归档底栏计数：' + f); if (T.labels().indexOf('已归档 1') === -1) throw new Error('搜索不应改变视图标签数量：' + T.labels()); T.click(T.q('.search-bar st-icon-button')[0]); await T.wait(320); return 'ok';
T.view('全部'); await T.wait(450); T.del('写周报'); await T.wait(500); return 'pending';

await T.ready('.shell'); T.view('垃圾桶'); await T.wait(500); if (T.items().length !== 1) throw new Error('垃圾桶应有 1 条，实际 ' + T.titles()); let r = await T.search('周报'); if (r.length !== 1 || r[0] !== '写周报') throw new Error('垃圾桶视图内搜索应命中该条目，实际 ' + r); r = await T.search('牛奶'); if (r.length !== 0) throw new Error('垃圾桶视图内搜索不应命中归档项，实际 ' + r); const e = T.empty(); if (!e || e.indexOf('没有符合「牛奶」的任务') === -1) throw new Error('垃圾桶视图无匹配时应有空状态文案，实际 ' + e); T.click(T.q('.search-bar st-icon-button')[0]); await T.wait(320); if (T.items().length !== 1) throw new Error('清除后垃圾桶应恢复 1 条，实际 ' + T.titles()); return 'ok';

let root = null; for (let i = 0; i < 30; i++) { const p = document.querySelector('o-page'); root = p && p.shadowRoot; if (root && root.querySelector('.shell')) break; await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 100)); } if (!root || !root.querySelector('.shell')) throw new Error('刷新后页面未就绪'); const inner = root.querySelector('.search-field').shadowRoot.querySelector('input'); if (inner.value !== '') throw new Error('刷新后搜索词应被清空（搜索词不进存储），实际 ' + inner.value); if (getComputedStyle(root.querySelector('.search-count')).display !== 'none') throw new Error('刷新后「找到 N 项」应隐藏'); if (root.querySelectorAll('.item').length !== 1) throw new Error('刷新后垃圾桶仍有 1 条，实际 ' + root.querySelectorAll('.item').length); return 'ok';

const { getStorage } = await import('/nos/storage/main.js'); const s = getStorage('conjure-todo-app-test'); sessionStorage.removeItem('__todo_store_id'); const o = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('__todo_test_backup_v1') || 'null'); if (o) { if (o.todos) await s.setItem('todos', o.todos); if (o.groups) await s.setItem('groups', o.groups); if (o.ui) await s.setItem('ui', o.ui); } localStorage.removeItem('__todo_test_dirty'); sessionStorage.removeItem('todo-ui-state'); return 'restored';
